definition.front: front[y,x] is feasible iff exists z with side[y,z] and top[z,x]
definition.side: side[y,z] is feasible iff exists x with front[y,x] and top[z,x]
definition.top: top[z,x] is feasible iff exists y with front[y,x] and side[y,z]
definition.capacity: number of opposite-axis samples satisfying the other two masks for each projection pixel
definition.expectedCoverage: mean per-target-pixel hit probability under sampleBudget uniform samples over the discrete visual hull support
